This entire saga traumatized my younger sister and the divorce was rough. I’m completely disgusted with my ex brother in law and so is my entire inner family. We’ve completely cut contact with him. 6. **Growth in Independence**: While caregiving is demanding, it can also encourage personal growth. You might become more self-reliant in managing your time, resources, or even your own emotional well-being.
